title: Slovakian Millet Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian-inspired pilaf made with millet, perfect for a satisfying vegan meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add millet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add cooked pilaf, zealous, and Slovakian parsley. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until millet is tender.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
